# `bootbox`

> `bootbox` is a hosted macOS and Linux bootstrap script for Homebrew, Brewfiles, current-user dotpackages, and 1Password-backed SSH keys.

`bootbox` takes a fresh supported machine to a reusable current-user foundation. Its primary entrypoint is `bootbox.sh` at `https://bootbox.tanaab.sh/bootbox.sh`.

It installs or uses Homebrew, makes the built-in Git, cURL, Zsh, jq, GNU Stow, and beta 1Password CLI core available, applies local or remote Brewfiles, stows dotpackages into `$HOME`, and optionally installs private SSH keys from 1Password.

`bootbox` supports macOS 26 or newer and 64-bit Linux on `x64` and `arm64`; CI covers Ubuntu 24.04. Sudo is limited to missing Homebrew installation. Existing Homebrew must already be manageable by the invoking user, and SSH keys, dotpackages, conflict backups, and home-directory operations never elevate.

The advanced reference covers installed components, platform requirements, the complete option and environment-variable contract, current-user and sudo behavior, shell setup guidance, and manual shared Homebrew access.

## Primary Resources

- [Hosted bootbox script](https://bootbox.tanaab.sh/bootbox.sh): Generated shell entrypoint for bootstrapping a macOS or Linux machine.
- [README source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tanaabased/bootbox/main/README.md): Primary quickstart, common usage, development, and project links.
- [Advanced source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tanaabased/bootbox/main/ADVANCED.md): Installed components, platform behavior, complete configuration reference, and shared Homebrew guidance.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tanaabased/bootbox): Source code, canonical documentation, workflows, and executable examples.
- [Releases](https://github.com/tanaabased/bootbox/releases): Published release tags for hosted script updates.
- [Issues](https://github.com/tanaabased/bootbox/issues): Bug reports, regressions, and feature requests.
